rooms.title: Precinct Front Desk
rooms.description: Sergeant Prakash gives Dana the Hale's Pharmacy break-in; the board holds case details; Dana signs out a camera. At the end, Dana files the complete case here.

rooms.title: Records Office
rooms.description: Dispatch and the records clerk. The dispatch log shows the Quayside Freight van out at 1:30 AM; the seized Quayside ledger ties the bottle's lot number to Warehouse 9 on Pier Road.

rooms.name: x
rooms.title: Main Street
rooms.description: Quiet brick shopfronts. Bud waits by the patrol car. Delivery driver Rick Mendez claims he arrived at 6 AM; showing him the dispatch log breaks his story and gets a statement about a Quayside van.

rooms.title: Hale's Pharmacy
rooms.description: The broken back window and the frightened pharmacist, Mrs. Hale. Photograph the window and bag the dropped pill bottle with its lot number.

rooms.title: Pier Road Warehouse
rooms.description: Warehouse 9. Bud warns against going in alone; entering twice without backup ends the case. Radio for backup, then arrest the suspect with the connected evidence.

exits.name: Pier Road back to Main Street (west)

facts.name: case
facts.text: Hale's Pharmacy, 14 Main Street, broken into overnight; boxes of prescription painkillers taken. Driver Rick Mendez of Quayside Freight claims he arrived at 6 AM and saw nothing. Dispatch log shows his van out at 1:30 AM. Confronted, he admits a 2 AM off-the-books run and saw a man carry pharmacy boxes into a Quayside van bound for Pier Road. The dropped bottle is lot 44-17; the Quayside ledger routes lot 44-17 to Warehouse 9. Suspect: Carl Voss, Quayside night foreman.

facts.name: flags
facts.text: f50 assigned (+10 room 1), f51 driver story checked (+25 room 3), f52 pharmacy documented (+30 room 4, needs photograph + bottle), f53 connected to warehouse (+40 room 2, needs statement + bottle), f54 arrest (+60 room 5, needs backup + f53), f55 case filed (+50 room 1), f56 board read, f57 wrong tray gag. Max score 215.

facts.name: filing
facts.text: Room 1 logic already handles 'file report': Prakash names any missing flag (51,52,53,54) so the paperwork can be corrected; when complete awards 50 and ends the shift.

facts.name: npcs
facts.text: Sgt. Prakash (room 1 desk, keeps a tray for forms completed in the wrong tray). Officer Bud Bukowski (partner, talkative, brave; room 3 by patrol car and room 5). Mrs. Hale the pharmacist (afraid of Quayside Freight). Dispatch (room 2 or via radio anywhere, dry and patient, repeats details).
